text:
nana: quick thread - thinking about a tiny change to the gateway request lifecycle to reduce duplicate streaming starts when client TCP flaps. want quick eyeballs before RFC.
ian: spitball it.
laura: tl;dr?
nana: current behavior: edge closes on short TCP loss -> frontdoor spins up fallback / hedges -> if client reconnects we sometimes start a new stream instead of resuming, causing duplicated model inferences. proposal: lightweight attach-resume probe that runs before creating a new upstream stream.
kevin: how is that probe different from the session-resume stuff we've seen?
nana: smaller scope: ephemeral probe only verifies "is there an active server-side session for this request id?" without creating a lease. it should be O(1) local check. no long-term state.
laura: sounds lower-risk. what's the probe flow?
nana: client reconnect -> proxy extracts X-Resume-Id (if present) -> run local probe to owner node via a tiny UDP-style RPC (low mem) -> if owner says alive, return attach token -> reattach; else proceed to full new stream.
ian: UDP-style RPC? reliability concerns.
nana: it's not raw UDP; it's a fire-and-forget low-latency control RPC over existing control plane. we accept occasional false negatives (we'll fall back to normal path) but want to avoid false positives.
kevin: what about hedging interplay? hedges spawn before probe completes?
nana: probe should be synchronous but very cheap (sub-ms). hedging is gated: hedges will carry a probe TTL header; if probe returns success, hedges short-circuit mid-flight. if probe hasn't returned by hedging deadline, hedges continue.
laura: failure modes: 1) probe says alive but owner actually finalized -> risk of attach failure and a small extra RTT. 2) probe says dead when it's alive -> extra work but correctness preserved. both acceptable.
kevin: metrics to watch?
nana: probe.latency, probe.false_positive_rate, resume_success_rate, duplicated-starts.
ian: rollout? feature flag, staged by route, and percent rollout.
laura: compatibility: SDKs optional. proxies should synthesize X-Resume-Id when starting long streams. add route-level flag resumable: optional. default off.
kevin: security: make probe idempotent and include HMAC on resume id. ensure we don't leak ids in logs.
nana: yep HMAC + scrub. GC: none needed because we store nothing. ops-bot: created feature flag ingress.attach_probe.enabled with default false.
laura: test plan? e2e with simulated packet drops + hedging; assert 90% reduction in duplicate upstream starts on target routes. also run chaos to ensure no increase in p99.
ian: small nit: ensure probe path is instrumented in traces so we can see probe vs full-new.
nana: will add span attr: control.probe=true|false.
kevin: i'm +1 for RFC. keep it focused and add toy sequence diagram.
laura: +1. ping me when draft is up.
infra-bot: note: ticket created INFRA-1127 to add probe RPC to control plane.
nana: thanks all, will draft tonight. :rocket:
